question_text: An investor divides her portfolio between two mutual funds. Fund X has an annual return of $8\%$ and Fund Y has an annual return of $12\%$. At the end of the first year, the overall portfolio return is $10\%$. If the amount originally invested in Fund X had been twice as much and the amount in Fund Y had been half as much, the overall portfolio return would have been $9\%$ instead. What was the ratio of the original investment in Fund X to the original investment in Fund Y?
